title: peer-critique-panel: pilot harness, prototype, records and paper source
description: Software and records accompanying the working paper A Tiered Peer-Critique Architecture for AI Answers by George W. Lott (all versions: 10.5281/zenodo.22325882). The archive holds the pilot harness (Python; runs a panel of models from several labs through OpenRouter, with a hub that questions the panel's answer, and the single-model baselines), the single-file browser prototype of the protocol, the generated task sets, every model call and every per-task record of the pilots with the reports built from them, and the paper's HTML and PDF with the script that builds the PDF.
notes: The code is MIT licensed; the paper's text is CC BY 4.0. Cite the paper record for the work and this record for the code and data.
